atlas.reference_note: no committed reference atlas for Arthur

scale.measured_from: base bottom (z = 0) to the highest vertex of the head part tripo_part_5 (crown). The sword tip is higher and is not the figure height (04 §3.3: height 52-56 uu of the figure; the UCP capsule 36x62 uu includes the sword)
scale.seat: body and sword are scaled uniformly about the source base top and placed on the normalised base top (z = base height); the base is normalised separately to its footprint
scale.choice_note: 0.55 m inside the proposed 52-56 uu of 04 §3.3; same top as the Medusa candidate for the K-1 pair

materials.note: Blender material of the atlas (FBX slot name)

body.join: all parts except the base, the dropped parts and the sword split off tripo_part_12

drop_parts.tripo_part_14: 4 triangles in a 0.4 x 0.4 mm patch at the neck, 2 loose islands; degenerate Tripo segment (Tripo-stage report)

weapon_split.between: sword if the base-colour texel under the polygon is saturated (HSV s > saturation_min and v > value_min: bronze guard/pommel, leather grip) or the polygon centre is within grip_radius_m of the fitted sword axis; otherwise hand (grey gauntlet fist)
weapon_split.smoothing: connected components (welded topology) of one class smaller than min_island_polygons are given to the other class; repeated until stable

grip_bridge.why: Tripo modelled no grip inside the fist: after the split the sword is two islands (guard + blade, grip stub + pommel) with a gap hidden by the fist (review frame closeup_sword_only of the first build). An open cylinder on the fitted axis makes the separate weapon whole; UVs sit inside the grip leather texels. Geometric repair, not art-accepted

weapon_split.source_thresholds_note: chosen on the source GLB: guard >= z 0.625, pommel < z 0.545, grip radius 0.013 source units (x 0.58333 + seat)

closure.why: verify 2026-09-28 (two independent reviews, major): the Tripo base part tripo_part_1 has 4 open footprint holes in its top (74 boundary edges, ~47 cm2) and the boot soles of tripo_part_3/4 are open (64 boundary edges below z 0.075 m). In the source they sit under the boot walls; after the base normalisation (XY x0.604, Z x1.506 against the figure's uniform x0.583) they no longer match: see-through crescents around the toes at rest with a one-sided material, dark openings in the base top when a foot lifts (LungeAttack step, DeathSettle). The texels of the hole regions are black and the bake left a bronze boot fringe around them. Geometric repair, not art-accepted

base_top.method: the flat top (z = base height, normal +Z) is one planar UV chart: affine XY->UV fitted on it; flat top faces within region_max_distance_from_hole_m of a hole whose texels are dark (unused, black) or bronze (dilated by mip_bleed_px) are removed with the hole; each resulting boundary loop is capped flat at the top; loop vertices below the top (crack ends) get a raised copy and a vertical wall; cap/wall UVs = the same affine map shifted by the smallest pixel offset that puts the footprint (+ mip_bleed_px) on clean flat-top texels (FFT search); corner normals +Z (walls: face normal)
base_top.mip_bleed_note: 8 px = half a mip-4 block: at the game camera the 30 uu base (600 texels) covers ~75 px, i.e. mip ~3
base_top.region_note: a flat face joins the region only if all its vertices are within this distance of a hole vertex: compact caps; keeps the long fan triangles and the dark crack line between the toe holes (a crack of the slab) out
base_top.horizontal_cap_note: openings with a smaller area in XY are vertical: short Tripo hole walls left standing as free ribbons once the flat faces around them are removed; those wall faces are removed (below the top, near a hole only)
base_top.tone_note: donor pick: among the clean areas that fit, the nearest whose mean BC luminance and tangent-normal R/G (the Tripo normal map has broad tilted bands on the top) are within tone_tolerance of the median clean texels 12-40 px around the footprint (else the closest by max(|diff|/tol))

fringe_reuv.note: kept faces of the top's planar UV chart (flat top and rim chamfer) with a vertex within region_max_distance_from_hole_m of a hole that still sample bronze fringe or black hole texels (long fan triangles) get their UVs moved onto clean stone per edge-connected group; geometry unchanged

base_top.fold_fix_note: the Tripo top has a few overlapping slivers; a cap loop along one needs a flipped triangle: the flat faces next to it are removed too and the caps rebuilt
base_top.uv_scale_note: cap UVs keep the stone's texel density (1.0) unless no clean area fits the footprint; then they are scaled down about their centre (the flat-top stone is nearly uniform)
base_top.dirty_note: measured on the BC flat top: stone v 0.196-0.22 (p1-p95), s 0.02-0.08; bronze fringe hue 20-45, s > 0.3

soles.method: boundary loops of the foot parts entirely below z_max are filled flat (normal down); UVs a small rectangle inside the UV triangle of the loop's largest neighbour (sole-rim texels, as the grip bridge); weights come from the heat solve of the foot group

weld.scope: inside every part (never across parts), before the split
weld.normals: corner normals are captured once after import as a float corner attribute and re-applied after weld/split (custom normals are stored relative to smoothing fans, which topology edits change)

orientation.method_note: per polygon: a ray along +normal and one along -normal (offset 1e-4 of height) against the whole candidate; area where only the +normal ray escapes counts outward, only the -normal ray escapes counts inward; score = (out - in) / (out + in)
orientation.expected_note: measured on the Tripo GLB 2026-09-28 (headless probe): every part >= 0.997, no inside-out part (unlike Medusa parts 8/10/13/14)
orientation.fix: flip polygon winding and negate the custom corner normals (as build_candidate.py)

armature.object_note: rig-contract.json skeletons.UM_HUMANOID_17_v1.armature_object.name (proposed): one armature object name for every character of the skeleton
armature.placement_note: joints measured on this mesh (final metres): slices of the limb parts and orthographic front/side renders with a 5 cm grid; weapon = grip point on the fitted sword axis at fist height -> blade tip (the builder checks both against the geometry)

weights.method: Blender automatic weights (bone heat, parent_set ARMATURE_AUTO) per part group, restricted to the group's bones (other bones use_deform off during the solve); rigid groups 100 % on one bone; then cleanup
weights.coordinates_frame_note: height_ramps in final metres (candidate frame after scale and seat)
weights.smoothing_note: no edge smoothing of weights: tried (2 iterations, factor 0.5) and it raised the probe-pose edge stretch (arm_l_raise max 1.46x -> 3.10x, 17 edges > 1.5x), because Tripo's retopology has long edges joining distant regions
weights.fallback: vertices the heat solve leaves unweighted get 1.0 on the nearest allowed bone (point-segment distance); counted per part

groups.why: head, hair and crown move as one (rig-contract §9.1)
gauntlet fist without finger bones; the sword is split off
tassets follow the thighs at the hem only; heat gave leg_upper.R up to 0.76 at belt height (z 0.34) next to hips 0.89 (2.8x edge stretch in the thigh_r_flex probe pose, first build)

cloak: rig-contract §9.4 hips with a soft transition to leg_upper at the hem only (ramp: no leg weight above the hip line; heat gave leg_upper.R 0.29 at z 0.41 inside the cloak, 3.8x edge stretch in thigh_r_flex, first build); cap keeps the hem from swinging fully with a thigh; second ramp: the collar hangs from the shoulders on spine (heat mixed hips/spine abruptly there: 2.15x on 3-6 mm collar edges in spine_bend_fwd)

part_roles.tripo_part_7: left forearm and open left hand
part_roles.tripo_part_11: cloth between the cloak halves at the upper back

anatomy.head: tripo_part_5
anatomy.feet_sink_note: lowest foot vertex within 3 mm of the base top (source: the feet sink 1.3 mm)
anatomy.note: part roles named by the profile; the build also detects them from the geometry (report anatomy.auto, disagreements listed). Front: the head part is closed (its mean normal is no front indicator), so the sword ahead of the body and the toes ahead of the ankles are used

axes.weapon_side_note: sword in the character's right hand; .L = +X, so the right hand is -X (rig-contract side_convention)
axes.front_indicators: sword centroid in front of the body axis (y < 0) and toe tips in front of the ankles; the head part is closed, its mean normal is not a front indicator (Medusa used the open face part)
axes.fbx: fbx_preset (UM_FBX_v1): export_space_rotation_z_degrees 90, -Y forward, Z up, FBX_SCALE_UNITS, data x100, UnitScaleFactor patched to 1.0, Triangulate on
axes.expected_ue_front_source: 04-blender-production.md §1 «Оси» + §1.1 preset UM_FBX_v1; verified by ART-001 — a standard, not a proposal; UE map measured on the Medusa candidate: ue(x, y) = (-y_blender, -x_blender)

exports.path_mode_note: STRIP (bare texture names) instead of the preset's AUTO: textures reach UE from the atlas stage, not through the FBX

sockets.name: Weapon
sockets.purpose: Holy Avenger VFX (CUE-014); the weapon bone head is the grip point on the fitted sword axis, the bone runs up the blade to the tip

sockets.name: Head
sockets.location_note: null: the build predicts the UE bone-space offset (build-report sockets[].location_uu_for_ue = the Blender bone-local target with y negated, because the UE FBX import mirrors Y) and ue-import sets it; verify get_socket_location(Head) = target_ue_component_uu within 0.05 uu in a live frame
sockets.target_note: bounding-box centre of the head part tripo_part_5 (face, hair, crown)

team_color.applicability: open: AD-CNF-58 (TeamColor only on base/ring per 03 С-11, or on the figure material per 04). The mask is produced as an optional input; the base is a separate mesh and can carry the team colour on its own
team_color.mask_rule: red cloth (cloak, tabard, back cloth): HSV hue >= 340 or <= 10 deg, s >= 0.55, v in [0.10, 0.85] on the BC atlas, Gaussian soft edge sigma 1 px, only inside part cells. Measured on this atlas: cloak red hue 340-12, s 0.65-0.76, v 0.26-0.37; skin hue 15-32, s <= 0.58 (head reddish pixels s median 0.39)

mask.note: built by the atlas stage (candidate/atlas.py) as an atlas output; formerly scripts/team_mask_arthur.py (mask_params above)

ue.instances_note: 03 С-11 team colours as linear ≈ hex/255 (17 AD-CNF note, proposal)
ue.team_color_mode_note: mask: BaseColor = lerp(BC, BC x TeamColor, TeamMask.R) (proposal; AD-CNF-58 open); multiply: BC x TeamColor everywhere (Medusa T4); none: BC only
